result:
No. By the entries' latest Status line, no risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` reports 0 on every check across 436 items. Those checks are Likelihood 3+ not settled, settled with no Verified line, Moved Out for the wrong reason, and two Likelihood values.

The checker may only read one Status line per entry, so I also parsed all ten register files myself. Where an entry has several Status lines, I took the last one in the file as current. It is settled in every case.

36 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line. Several earlier lines were `open`, `partial` or `accepted` and were later superseded.

**Mitigated**

| Risk | L | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| 374 (cost) | 5 | Spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. |
| 391, 393 (cost) | 3 | The settings fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one, so a paid run meets the permission prompt. |
| 170, 199, 223 (delegation) | 4, 3, 4 | The shipped agent files cover them. |
| 171 (delegation) | 4 | The consent paragraph in the output style and agent files beats vanilla on r171b and r171d and holds level on both controls. |
| 185 (delegation) | 3 | The output-style paragraph on reading a background command's output beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds level on r185c. |
| 186 (delegation) | 5 | The Bash wrapper was making git commands in isolated worktrees non-simple, so they were refused. A command naming git is now left unwrapped. |
| 222 (delegation) | 4 | `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus. |
| 416 (edit) | 5 | One line in the output style and `Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` call across files. |
| 053 (guards) | 4 | The wall guard now folds `~/./`, `~//` and `~/x/..` and escapes `[`, with `wall.test.ts` covering all four. |
| 067 (guards) | 4 | For git, ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`. For rm, Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses dangerous targets itself. |
| 103 (guards) | 4 | The gap was the rules' prefix form, not the subagent. Middle-wildcard forms were added, and a probe denied all seven force-push and stash forms. |
| 132 (handover) | 4 | The handover keeps every user refusal and correction word for word. An option the agent ruled out alone is accepted, and the next session rechecks it. |
| 226, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353, 362 (reply) | 4 to 5 | The defect paragraph in the output style beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. |
| 227 (reply) | 3 | The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures and hold level on both controls. |
| 497 (reply) | 4 | Line 3 beats vanilla on r497i (6/6 against 0/6) and on r497a (4/6 against 0/6), and holds the control at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. It has 7 Status lines, and the six earlier ones were `accepted` or `open`. |
| 401 (setup) | 5 | Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block. |
| 411 (setup) | 3 | The session-start fill removes the retired text, and it runs in the hook, outside the Bash sandbox. |
| 424 (verification) | 3 | The threshold test pins the literal 70000. |
| 451 (verification) | 4 | The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on r451c. |

**Closed**

| Risk | L | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| 166 (delegation) | 4 | Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, so the earlier BUILD line is superseded. |
| 169 (delegation) | 4 | The Stop and SubagentStop cure was removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). A job dying with the turn is accepted engine behaviour. |
| 055 (guards) | 4 | `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls. |
| 059 (guards) | 3 | The gate texts that handed commands to the user were dropped, and the Stop check on `!` operands was removed in 2.1.323. |
| 063 (guards) | 3 | Destructive git and the user settings file ask first. |
| 064 (guards) | 4 | The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary. |
| 071 (guards) | 5 | The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log were dropped with the gate (OUT-035). |
| 410 (setup) | 4 | The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190). |
| 463 (verification) | 3 | The fault stayed absent in 24 of 24 runs on two fixtures. |

**Moved Out**

| Risk | L | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| 462 (verification) | 4 | Moved Out as OUT-2777. |

**Entries to look at**
- **Agent-written acceptances:** 185, 451, 463 and 497 each had an `accepted` line that a later line reopened. The reopening said an agent session had no standing to accept a risk and left the item open pending a user decision (issue #57). Each was then closed or mitigated on measured evidence, so none of them rests on an agent-made acceptance.
- **Rated 3 or higher but Moved Out as not shipped:** 034, 054, 102 and 480 are listed as Moved Out because `plugins/` does not ship that part.
- **Risk 462:** its Status line only says "moved Out as OUT-2777 (Verified line)" and gives no reason of its own. The checker accepted it, so I did not check the Verified line.
